ns2:course.label: Video Storytelling 2-Producing
ns2:course.description: Advanced techniques for reporting, producing, writing, shooting, and editing video news stories and for producing and airing regularly scheduled news programs on deadline. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JOUR 340. May not be taken concurrently with JOUR 217 or JOUR 417. May be taken concurrently with JOUR 317.
